anomalies.detail: Foundation unlock chart was never rebased after the September 2026 burn. Under the 'Total Supply: 300M' header, the last chart point (Dec 2027) reads 339,864,227 — more tokens than the entire post-burn supply. Y-axis still runs to 350M.
The chart's 'Now' point shows 237,417,698 unlocked while the pie chart next to it says 61.96% unlocked (~185.9M). Two widgets, two different stories, same page.
61.98% unlocked minus 48.55% in circulation = 13.43% of supply (~40.3M STREAM) that is unlocked but not circulating. The site never says where those tokens sit.

method: mint account read via public mainnet RPC (getTokenSupply, getParsedAccountInfo); burn tx confirmation; foundation chart + pie read in the same session; arithmetic cross-checks. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

missing.detail: For a team whose product is verifiable vesting, the site links no vesting contract IDs behind the two largest locked buckets. This is the exact gap the UnlockLens registry is built to close.
missing.value: Investors 27.07% / Contributors 10.69% — no contract IDs published
